name: Junjou Romantica ~Koi no Dokidoki Daisakusen~
original_name: 純情ロマンチカ ～恋のドキドキ大作戦～
source:
Usami is a famous novelist. He somehow finishes his novel just in time and he is about to start his next work. At the same time, Misaki is told to control Usami's schedule. "Well, no problem! I'll do it!" Will Misaki be able to successfully control Usami's schedule and make him keep a deadline...?

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/11552]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
宇佐见是一位著名小说家。他总算及时完成小说，正准备开始下一部作品。与此同时，美咲被要求管理宇佐见的日程。“嗯，没问题！交给我吧！”美咲能否成功安排宇佐见的时间，让他按期交稿……？

[摘自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/11552]Himeya Shop[/url]]
